Kubernetes Gateway ExporterExposure Inventory & Telemetry

Maps Gateway API routes to Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics with native SLSA Level 3 security.

View Architecture
View on GitHub

🌐 Gateway API Native

Automatically maps Gateway → Listener → HTTPRoute → Service relationships and exposes them as Prometheus gauges.

📊 OTLP / OpenTelemetry

Supports native pushing via gRPC to OpenTelemetry Collectors alongside standard Prometheus /metrics scraping.

🛡️ SLSA Level 3

Cryptographically signed artifacts (Cosign), keyless OIDC attestations, and full SBOMs for every release.

🚀 Zero Noise

Cache-backed Kubernetes Informers with minimal RBAC privileges ensure high performance and low API server load.

🔍 Cross-Namespace Ready

Seamlessly resolves complex networking topologies including ReferenceGrants for cross-namespace routing.

✅ CI/CD Hardened

Integrated Trivy scanning, Govulncheck call-graph analysis, and OSSF Scorecard validations.
